Hiring for DATA SCIENCE Instructor - Offline Learning Centres 
Location - Assam
NP - 7-10 Days
CTC -15LPA

About the Role
As an Instructor at our Offline Learning Centres, you will deliver engaging sessions in Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and related fields to students and working professionals. You will play a vital role in ensuring high-quality learning outcomes through classroom teaching, mentorship,
and academic support. This is a unique opportunity to combine your passion for technology and
education, while shaping the careers of tomorrow.
Key Responsibilities
• Deliver in-person lectures and training sessions in Data Science, Machine Learning, Deep
Learning and related domains.
• Guide learners through concepts, case studies, and projects to ensure strong understanding
and application.
• Collaborate with Centre Managers and academic teams to monitor learner progress and
outcomes.
• Support students with doubt-solving, mentorship, and building career-ready skills.
• Continuously update knowledge and content to stay current with industry trends and tools.Skills & Experience
• Minimum 2+ years of teaching/training experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or
related fields.
• Strong programming skills in Python and understanding of SQL, Excel.
• Solid grasp of ML/DL concepts such as Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests,
Ensemble methods, Neural Networks, NLP, Recommendation Systems, etc.
• Strong communication, presentation, and mentoring skills.
• Comfortable with both classroom delivery and online teaching (camera-facing).
• Education: BE/ B.Tech (minimum); Postgraduate preferred.
Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate
on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual
orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employment is decided on the
basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.
